name: nldbd-energy-resolution
description: Energy-regression extension of the NLDBD packet: a model predicts each event's energy from the detector inputs; scored by physics resolution of the predicted spectrum (peak FWHM), not MSE. Uses the frozen splits and labeled subsets of nldbd-energy-matched-auc v1.2, imported read-only.

label_regimes.subset: validation.freeze_splits.labeled_subset_positions over the regression train table, seed of benchmark.json label_regimes

gates.local_gain_note: the FWHM is divided by the local gain (slope of E_pred vs E_ref on events whose REFERENCE energy lies in sidebands line +-[4 s, 4 s + w], s = max(sigma_ref, sigma_pred), w = 8 s, widened up to 12 s until each band holds >= 200 events (>= 50 required), two low bands when the spectrum ends above the line); a gain outside 1 +- 0.2 makes the line not reportable (widened from 0.1 on 2026-10-25, user: the FWHM is already divided by the gain, so moderate shrinkage is corrected; EXO-200 regressors at 1 %/10 % labels sit at 0.85-0.90). Guards against a regressor that narrows a peak by compressing the energy scale around it.

mjd.inputs: classification view (raw_waveform, baseline-subtracted, max-normalised) + log(scale) + detector index
mjd.headline: FWHM at Q_bb(76Ge) = 2039.06 keV from FWHM(E) = sqrt(a + b E + c E^2) (a, b, c >= 0) fitted through the reportable curve lines (needs >= 4, at least one above 1.5 MeV: DEP 1592.5, 1620.5 or 2614.5; Q_bb lies between DEP and SEP). 2614.5 is optional: the spectrum ends just above it and regressors' predictions are often cut off there (user 2026-10-25). Secondary, reported directly: FWHM at the DEP 1592.5 (not Doppler-broadened), the SEP 2103.5 (closest line to Q_bb; Doppler-broadened, the same for every model, never in the curve) and 2614.5

exo200.inputs: classification view (226 x 300 waveforms, baseline-subtracted, max-normalised) + log(scale)
exo200.headline: sigma/E at 2614.5 keV (closest clean line to Q_bb(136Xe) = 2457.8 keV; the spectrum starts at the 512 keV threshold)
exo200.peak_model_note: the Rotated_energy 2614.5 peak has a low-energy tail: Gauss + tail + step fits the reference with chi2/ndf 1.5 (Gauss + step 3.1); the +-5 sigma window keeps the 2382 keV Compton edge out; FWHM 79.0 keV stable for 4-6 sigma windows

supernemo.inputs: classification view (tracker hits tX tY tZ tR only); calorimeter energies are never inputs
supernemo.headline: FWHM of the residual E_pred - E_ref over the 0nubb test events (2.3548 x 1.4826 x MAD, keV); the trivial floor (constant prediction) is reported beside it; secondary: half-maximum FWHM of the predicted 0nubb spectrum
supernemo.sources_note: training and selection on 0nubb only (user 2026-10-25): training on the 2nubb/Bi214 continua made the 0nubb residual grow with more labels (Region+MLP 533/688/1343 keV at 1/10/100 %)

peak_models.gauss_tail_step: (1 - f - f_h) Gaussian + f low-energy and f_h high-energy Gaussian-convolved exponential tails + erfc step + linear background (HPGe shape with a high-side tail for model predictions); FWHM = half-maximum width of the full signal shape
